rulings.scope: Credit for refuting Conjecture 4.7 of arXiv:2502.02826 (pmd(C_m □ C_n) = 6 on the listed cases) via its explicitly listed case (3,4): pmd(C_3 □ C_4) = 5. The additional (3,5), (3,6), (3,7) certificates are supporting evidence of the same family and earn no separate credit.

rulings.prior_art: QUALIFIED_PASS: the Genova thesis (Tolosa Villarreal, 2025) read through an alternative open copy, with no torus table or target value; the companion and citing works screened; registries clean at the reviewer's heads.
rulings.significance: QUALIFIED_PASS, modest: a genuine counterexample to a deliberately unresolved, explicitly named case, found by a finite search, plus a short regular-graph lower bound giving exact value 5.
